import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Data Preprocessing
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese'], ordered=True)

# Set up the visualization style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 14))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Factors Analysis', fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# --- Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level ---
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Sleep Duration',
    sizes=(100, 400),
    palette={'None': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'},
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    style='Occupation'
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Factors', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))
axes[0, 0].set_ylim(3.5, 6.5) # Adjust y-axis for clarity
axes[0, 0].set_xlim(5.5, 8.5) # Adjust x-axis for clarity


# --- Plot 2: Physical Activity vs. Heart Rate ---
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='Physical Activity Level',
    y='Heart Rate',
    fill=True,
    thresh=0,
    levels=5,
    cmap="viridis",
    ax=axes[0, 1]
)
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Physical Activity Level',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='BMI Category',
    size='Daily Steps',
    sizes=(100, 400),
    palette={'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f1c40f', 'Obese': '#c0392b'},
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    edgecolor='black'
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity vs. Heart Rate', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Resting Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='BMI & Steps', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))

# --- Plot 3: Sleep Duration by Occupation and BMI ---
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='BMI Category',
    jitter=0.15,
    dodge=True,
    size=15,
    palette={'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f1c40f', 'Obese': '#c0392b'},
    linewidth=1,
    edgecolor='gray',
    ax=axes[1, 0]
)
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    showfliers=False,
    boxprops={'facecolor':'None'},
    whiskerprops={'linewidth':0},
    showcaps=False,
    width=0.7
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation & BMI', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].get_legend().remove() # Remove redundant legend

# --- Plot 4: Blood Pressure Distribution ---
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Systolic BP',
    y='Diastolic BP',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Age',
    sizes=(150, 450),
    palette={'None': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'},
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    style='BMI Category',
    edgecolor='black'
)
# Add reference lines for hypertension stages
axes[1, 1].axhline(80, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 1].axvline(130, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 1].text(125.5, 92, 'Elevated', color='gray', ha='right')
axes[1, 1].text(142, 82, 'Hypertension', color='gray', ha='right')

axes[1, 1].set_title('Blood Pressure by Health Indicators', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Systolic BP (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Diastolic BP (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Factors', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
